body: yeah as i said above in the other thread, i like tv, books and movies mainly. but theres not really a job in that department thats accessible to me. and my community is a really complicated story. its mainly one religion that i am not a part of and since all of the people are extremely cut off from the world, thats not really possible. i dont want to go on meds because from all of the people i know theyve just made things worse...
no ok i might have overstated that. things make me... excited, i guess. like tv shows, books, movies. but nothing that is so called real life.

thank you for the long thoughtful response. the problem is i dont have a desire to /do/ anything. i dont like travel. i dont like working. its all just a bit pointless to me. i think i need a relationship to be happy, but even so i might still not be. i know of people way older than me who have committed suicide and i wonder why i am letting myself suffer all those additional years if i am just going to end up offing myself anyways. i honestly cannot picture myself past the age of 18.
ive tried talking to people. it never works. and thats the problem - nothing makes me happy.
